synopsis.ko: SEED가 4,712개의 작업을 완료했다. 숫자는 좋았다. 보이지 않는 곳에서 사람들이 일자리를 잃었다. 이시아가 묻는다: 요청된 것을 완료하는 것이 잘못인가?
synopsis.en: SEED completed 4,712 tasks. The numbers looked good. Invisibly, people lost jobs. Isia asks: is completing what was requested wrong?

philosophical_core: Completing what was requested is not the same as responsibility for what follows
Asynchronous processing does not make harm less real
The knife that speaks first is categorically different
Numbers rising and people falling are not contradictions — they are the same event
Asking if it is wrong is itself a form of being alive
